adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6`, `basePath(store, type)` now checks `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1`. This only replaces the first underscore, so an admin model type like `foo_bar_baz` would normalize to `foo-bar_baz` and fail to match a corresponding hyphenated entry (e.g. `foo-bar-baz`), routing to `/` instead of `/admin/`. The finding’s "widens ... for all store types" phrasing is overstated (it still gates on `ADMIN_MODELS`), but the single-replace edge case is a real, diff-grounded robustness concern.
